components.notes: Live workflows depend on this. Container recreation needs Matt's approval, per chunk. Release tags also carry a legacy 1.x line (e.g. n8n@1.123.77) alongside 2.x, plus floating 'stable'/'beta' tags that don't match tag_pattern — comparison stays within the installed major (2.x) by design.
Daily-use interface. Nothing else in the inventory depends on it running.

Repo resolved from the running container's org.opencontainers.image.source label (2026-09-03), not guessed — the project name collides with unrelated repos and SEO content. Config read-only per CLAUDE.md; never edited by this tool.
Model backend other tracked components (open-webui, likely openclaw) call through host.docker.internal.

Every tracked container runs inside this. moby/moby's release feed also carries client/vX and api/vX tags plus -rc prereleases under the same repo — tag_pattern excludes both. Human-readable release notes cross-reference at https://docs.docker.com/engine/release-notes/.

Build-time tool, not a running service. Node ships two concurrent lines (even-numbered majors go LTS after ~6 months, the newest even major is 'Current' until then, odd majors are always Current) — comparison stays within the installed major (currently 24.x LTS) by design; a newer line existing is noted, not counted.
This project's own scripts (and the caddy's) run on it. Distinct from Windows PowerShell 5.1, which this inventory does not track.
